title: NfcTagV1
description: Canonical representation of a managed NFC tag entry.

uid.description: Canonical lowercase hexadecimal UID representation without separators (e.g. 045ab23c9d8001).

name.description: Optional user-assigned name or nickname for the tag.

firstSeen.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the tag was first discovered.

lastRead.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent read or write interaction.

readCount.description: Total number of times this tag has been read or accessed.

lastAction.description: Most recent action performed with this tag in NFCWeb.

tagType.description: Hardware IC chip hint (e.g. NTAG213, MIFARE Ultralight, FeliCa).

hasNdef.description: Whether the tag has active formatted NDEF records.

records.description: Array of NDEF records stored on this tag.
